title: Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Role Purpose:**
The Talent Acquisition Executive will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment activities for EPC and Infrastructure projects, ensuring timely hiring of quality talent across project and corporate roles. The role involves sourcing, pipeline creation, volume hiring, project-based hiring, stakeholder coordination, recruitment tracking, ATS management, and delivering an excellent candidate experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Recruitment
* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition receipt to candidate onboarding.
* Source, screen, shortlist, interview coordinate, negotiate offers, and facilitate candidate joining.
* Ensure timely closure of assigned positions within defined turnaround timelines.
* Maintain a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Volume & Project-Based Hiring
* Support bulk hiring requirements for ongoing and upcoming EPC/Infrastructure projects.
* Execute hiring drives for project-based manpower requirements across multiple locations.
* Recruit talent for functions such as:
* Civil Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Planning & Contracts
* Procurement
* QS & Billing
* QA/QC
* Safety
* Plant & Machinery
* Project Management and Corporate Functions
* Participate in walk-in drives, job fairs, and recruitment campaigns.
* Talent Pipeline Creation
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
* Develop and manage talent pools through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and networking.
* Maintain an active database of shortlisted candidates for recurring project requirements.
* Track market availability of key skill sets and niche talent.
* Recruitment Tracker Management & MIS
* Maintain recruitment trackers with accurate and up-to-date hiring information.
* Publish periodic recruitment reports and hiring status updates.
* Track key recruitment metrics including:
* Open Positions
* Ageing Positions
* Interview-to-Selection Ratio
* Offer-to-Join Ratio
* Source Effectiveness
* Hiring Status Reports
* Ensure data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Stakeholder Management
* Coordinate with hiring managers, project teams, and department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Schedule interviews and provide regular recruitment updates.
* Ensure smooth communication between candidates and stakeholders.
* Build positive working relationships with internal business teams.
* ATS & Recruitment Systems Management
* Manage candidate records through Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* Update requisition status, interview feedback, and candidate progression in the ATS.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment processes and data management standards.
* Utilize recruitment technology for sourcing and hiring efficiency.
* Sourcing & Market Mapping
* Leverage multiple sourcing channels including:
* Job Portals
* LinkedIn Recruiter
* Employee Referrals
* Social Media Platforms
* Recruitment Consultancies
* Internal Databases
* Conduct market mapping for critical and recurring project roles.
* Identify passive candidates and build strong talent networks.
* Employer Branding & Candidate Experience
* Represent the organization professionally during candidate interactions.
* Promote the company's employer brand through recruitment campaigns and social media initiatives.
* Ensure a seamless and engaging candidate experience from sourcing to onboarding.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Number of positions closed within TAT.
* Hiring fulfillment percentage.
* Offer acceptance and joining ratio.
* Candidate pipeline readiness.
* Tracker accuracy and reporting compliance.
* Stakeholder satisfaction.
* Quality of hires.
* ATS data accuracy and process adherence.

**Preferred Industry Experience**
**EPC | Infrastructure | Construction | Roads & Highways | Metro | Railways | Power | Renewable Energy | Industrial Projects | Data Centers | Manufacturing**
**Work Experience**
**Desired Candidate Profile**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 2-6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition.
* Experience in EPC, Infrastructure, Construction, Manufacturing, Power, Renewable Energy, Engineering, or Industrial sectors preferred.
* Exposure to volume hiring and project-based recruitment is mandatory.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of recruitment lifecycle management.
* Experience in ATS platforms and recruitment tools.
* Recruitment tracker and MIS management.
* Sourcing through job portals and LinkedIn.
* Candidate pipeline building and talent mapping.
* MS Excel and data reporting skills.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management capability.

title: VP, Head Talent Acquisition
description:
**Role Overview**

The position holder will be accountable for ensuring that the business has the right talent, that new hires are successfully converted into productive employees, and that high-performing employees are retained. The role owns the business-facing talent journey from manpower planning and hiring through onboarding, induction, training, early-life hand-holding, productivity and retention. This is a business-facing HR leadership role, with the primary mandate to build and retain a productive business / sales organization.

Core accountability: Plan → Hire → Onboard → Induct → Train → Hand-hold → Become Productive → Retain

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Business Manpower Planning & Resourcing**

• Translate business plans and growth targets into manpower requirements and hiring plans.

• Partner with business leaders on organization design, manpower productivity and critical talent

requirements.

• Build robust talent pipelines for critical and difficult-to-fill positions.

**B. Talent Acquisition**

• Own lateral and campus hiring for business functions, including sourcing, selection, offer-to-join and candidate experience.

• Improve hiring quality, speed and productivity; strengthen employee referrals, talent networks and employer branding.

• Partner with Corporate HR on recruitment technology, process design and analytics.

**C. Onboarding, Induction & Early-Life Success**

• Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for new business / sales employees across the 70+ branch-office network.

• Ensure timely completion of corporate induction, business induction, product/process training and role-specific preparation.

• Design and drive structured 30/60/90-day onboarding and hand-holding journeys.

• Ensure each new joiner has clear expectations, a manager/buddy support mechanism and regular early-life reviews.

• Identify and eliminate points of friction that contribute to early-life attrition.

**D. Capability & Productivity Ramp-Up**

• Define the capability and productivity milestones expected during the first 30, 60 and 90 days.

• Partner with Sales Leadership and Corporate L&D to ensure effective product training, sales/process training and on-the-job learning.

• Track time-to-productivity and intervene early where new joiners are not progressing as expected.

**E. Retention & Employee Engagement**

• Own retention of critical and high-performing business talent.

• Identify attrition risks and drive targeted interventions with business leaders.

• Track regrettable attrition and its underlying causes by branch, manager, hiring source and cohort.

• Drive engagement initiatives that directly support retention and productivity.

**F. Talent Management & Career Progression**

• Identify high-potential and critical talent within business functions.

• Partner with business leaders on career paths, succession and talent reviews.

• Support effective performance and development conversations within business teams.

**G. Business HR Partnership**

• Act as the primary HR partner to the CBO and Business Leadership Team.

• Provide people insights and recommendations for business decisions.

• Anticipate organizational and talent risks arising from growth, restructuring or changes in business priorities.

**Key Success Metrics**

• Manpower fulfillment against approved business plan

• Time-to-hire and hiring productivity

• Offer-to-join ratio and quality of hire

• New-joiner onboarding and training completion

• 30/60/90-day productivity milestone achievement

• Time-to-productivity

• Early Life Mortality (30/60/90-day attrition)

• 12-month retention and regrettable attrition

• Retention of critical and high-performing employees

• Employee engagement within business functions

**Ownership Model**

The role is accountable for the outcome of the new-joiner journey. Corporate HR / L&D provides the enterprise learning infrastructure, systems, content and analytics; Sales Leadership and Branch Managers are responsible for executing day-to-day on-the-job coaching and hand-holding.

**Key Skills**

• Strong commercial orientation and ability to work closely with business leaders.

• Strong stakeholder management, influencing and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Demonstrated experience in scaling organizations and improving hiring and retention outcomes.

Experience & Education

• 12+ years of HR experience with significant experience in Business HR, Talent Acquisition and retention.

• Strong experience supporting a large, distributed business / field-sales organization is highly desirable.

• Preferred industry background: IT/ITES, Media, Telecom, Hospitality or Service industries.

• Excellent academic record and a degree in HR from a reputed management institute.

**Perks & Benefits**

• Weekly Payroll: Industry-first weekly salary payouts

• iLeap Education Sponsorship: Reimbursement for any certified course

• Comprehensive Insurance: Medical, Personal Accident and Life coverage for you and your family

• Attractive Weekly Incentives

• Open-Door Policy

In this role, you will partner closely with business leaders, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, and the wider Talent Acquisition organization to understand business priorities and translate them into effective recruiting and sourcing strategies. * Lead, coach, and develop a geographically dispersed team of recruiters, creating a high-performance, collaborative, and results-oriented recruiting culture.

* Develop and maintain recruiting reports and performance dashboards that provide transparency into hiring progress, recruiting effectiveness, pipeline health, and key Talent Acquisition metrics.

* Experience supporting high-volume, complex, specialist, or senior-level hiring in a fast-paced environment.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Plant HR – Manufacturing Operations**

**Company:**
Amitoje India Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Human Resources

**Position:**
Plant HR / Factory HR

4–7 Years

**Industry:**
Manufacturing / Printing / Fabrication / Packaging

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Work from Office

(THIS IS AN IMMEDIATE JOINING)

**About Amitoje India**

Amitoje India Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing company specializing in innovative retail display solutions, branding, printing, and fabrication. We operate in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where workforce efficiency, operational discipline, and timely execution are critical.

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on
**Plant HR professional**
who can independently manage HR operations at our Noida manufacturing facility, with a strong focus on blue-collar workforce management, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Blue-Collar Recruitment & Workforce Planning**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment of factory workers, machine operators, helpers, technicians, supervisors, and other production personnel.
* Develop reliable recruitment channels through contractors, local references, manpower agencies, and direct hiring.
* Ensure timely availability of manpower according to production requirements.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for urgent manpower requirements.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and workforce attrition.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and joining formalities.

**2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late arrivals, overtime, and shift schedules.
* Ensure accurate attendance records through biometric systems and HRMS.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, deductions, incentives, and leave.
* Maintain employee records and ensure timely resolution of salary-related queries.
* Track absenteeism and implement corrective measures to improve workforce availability.
* Coordinate with production supervisors to ensure adequate manpower across shifts.

**3. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for factory employees.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary issues, and worker concerns.
* Maintain a positive and productive relationship between workers, supervisors, and management.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Address issues related to employee misconduct, absenteeism, and workplace behaviour through fair and documented processes.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate records relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages, overtime, and other statutory obligations.
* Coordinate with compliance consultants and government authorities whenever required.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and records required for inspections and audits.
* Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Support implementation of applicable occupational health, safety, and welfare requirements.

**5. Factory Discipline & HR Administration**

* Ensure adherence to factory rules, reporting timings, shift schedules, and workplace policies.
* Conduct regular shop-floor visits to understand workforce concerns and monitor discipline.
* Coordinate with production managers and supervisors on manpower utilization and productivity.
* Monitor employee movement, unauthorized absenteeism, and workplace conduct.
* Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Support smooth employee exits, handovers, and Full & Final Settlements.

**6. Contractor & Manpower Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractual manpower deployment, attendance, and performance.
* Verify contractor bills against approved attendance and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure availability of backup manpower during peak production periods.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.

**7. Performance Management & HR Reporting**

* Coordinate performance reviews for factory employees and supervisors.
* Identify recurring attendance, productivity, and behavioural concerns.
* Maintain HR dashboards covering manpower strength, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, and recruitment.
* Share daily and weekly manpower reports with management.
* Support initiatives to improve employee retention, discipline, and workforce productivity.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in HR or a related qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant.
* Strong experience handling blue-collar and contractual workforces.
* Practical understanding of factory HR operations and labour law compliance.
* Experience in printing, packaging, fabrication, engineering, or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong blue-collar recruitment capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and labour compliance.
* Experience managing factory attendance, overtime, and payroll coordination.
* Strong interpersonal skills and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and attendance management systems.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and working knowledge of English.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Plant HR will be evaluated on:

1. **Manpower Availability:**
   Ensuring adequate workforce availability as per production requirements.
2. **Recruitment TAT:**
   Timely closure of blue-collar and factory-level vacancies.
3. **Attendance & Absenteeism:**
   Improvement in workforce attendance and reduction in unplanned absenteeism.
4. **Employee Retention:**
   Reduction in avoidable blue-collar attrition.
5. **Payroll Accuracy:**
   Accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs.
6. **Statutory Compliance:**
   Timely compliance with applicable labour laws and documentation requirements.
7. **Factory Discipline:**
   Effective management of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.
8. **HR Reporting:**
   Timely and accurate submission of manpower and HR reports.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is
**not limited to desk-based HR operations**
.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, interacting directly with workers, resolving workforce issues, and coordinating closely with production teams.

The candidate must be resourceful, firm yet approachable, and capable of maintaining workforce discipline while ensuring fair treatment of employees.

**Most importantly, the person should take complete ownership of plant-level HR operations rather than depending on constant supervision.**

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About Valiance**

Valiance is a deep-tech AI and analytics consulting firm working with enterprises on cutting-edge solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data Science, Computer Vision, Data Engineering, and Cloud Engineering.

Our teams solve complex business problems for leading enterprises using modern AI technologies and data platforms. We are looking for a Technical Recruiter who can help us build exceptional engineering and AI teams by identifying, evaluating, and attracting high-quality technical talent.

**The Role**

We are looking for a recruiter who goes beyond sourcing resumes and matching keywords against job descriptions. Someone who understands technology, can recognize meaningful technical experience, distinguishes genuine expertise from superficial exposure, and exercises sound judgment when evaluating candidates.

You should be curious, proactive, analytical, and highly outcome-oriented. You should continuously learn from interview feedback, identify gaps in the recruitment process, and bring ideas to improve hiring quality and speed.

We value independent thinking, ownership, and the ability to make good decisions in ambiguous situations. AI tools should help you become more effective and productive, but your judgment, curiosity, and ability to identify talent must remain your own.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Screening & Talent Evaluation

* Evaluate resumes against job requirements by understanding the substance of a candidate's experience, not merely matching keywords or listed skills.
* Identify relevant projects, assess their complexity, understand the candidate's specific contributions, and evaluate the depth and duration of their hands-on experience.
* Distinguish between candidates who have genuinely built and deployed solutions and those with only academic exposure, superficial familiarity, or limited practical experience.
* Assess candidates for roles across Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Data Engineering, and related technical disciplines.
* Identify relevant transferable skills and non-obvious talent that may not have an exact keyword match with the job description.
* Apply sound judgment to shortlist candidates who merit further technical evaluation, while avoiding both false positives and the rejection of promising profiles.

2. Candidate Fitment & Hiring Judgment

* Evaluate candidates across technical relevance, problem-solving ability, communication, learning agility, motivation, ownership, and role-specific expectations.
* Recognize signals that indicate whether a candidate is suited to the role, the nature of consulting work, client-facing environments, and Valiance's working culture.
* Understand the differences between profiles that look similar on paper but vary significantly in capability, experience, and potential.
* Ask thoughtful screening questions to validate experience, uncover gaps, and establish whether a candidate's claims are supported by concrete examples.
* Maintain a high bar for hiring quality without unnecessarily narrowing the talent pool.

3. Learning from Interview Outcomes

* Systematically analyze feedback from technical interviews, hiring managers, and rejected candidates to understand what worked and what did not.
* Identify patterns in rejected profiles, including recurring gaps in technical depth, project experience, communication, or role fit.
* Translate feedback into improved screening criteria, sharper questions, better sourcing strategies, and more accurate shortlisting decisions.
* Track the quality of shortlisted candidates and continuously refine the recruitment process based on actual outcomes.
* Demonstrate measurable improvement in screening accuracy and hiring effectiveness over time.

4. Ownership, Agency & Continuous Improvement

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned hiring mandates, from understanding requirements and sourcing through screening, interview coordination, and offer closure.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, hiring risks, and opportunities to improve candidate quality, turnaround time, and conversion rates.
* Bring recommendations and challenge ineffective approaches constructively instead of waiting for instructions.
* Collaborate closely with hiring managers, interviewers, and the broader talent acquisition team to align on role expectations and hiring priorities.
* Follow through on commitments, communicate issues early, and remain accountable for outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Show curiosity, energy, and a genuine hunger to improve personal effectiveness and the overall quality of hiring.

5. Effective Use of AI & Recruitment Tools

* Use AI tools to improve sourcing, resume analysis, candidate research, interview preparation, and recruitment workflow efficiency.
* Apply independent judgment to validate AI-generated assessments, challenge incorrect conclusions, and identify context that automated screening may miss.
* Avoid relying on AI-generated shortlists without independently evaluating candidate experience, project relevance, technical depth, and role fit.
* Experiment with better recruitment workflows and share practical ideas that improve productivity without compromising hiring quality.
* Use AI responsibly, protecting candidate information and complying with company data security policies.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2–4 years of experience in technical recruitment, preferably hiring for Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Data Engineering, or software engineering roles.
* Prior experience recruiting for an AI company, data consulting firm, deep-tech organization, or technology product company is strongly preferred.
* A working understanding of technical concepts, project lifecycles, and the practical differences between commonly used technologies and skill sets.
* Strong analytical thinking and the ability to interpret resumes beyond keywords, titles, and years of experience.
* Evidence of good candidate judgment and the ability to distinguish high-quality profiles from superficially suitable ones.
* A track record of taking initiative, solving problems independently, and improving recruitment processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage technical hiring managers and ask clarifying questions.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with multiple hiring priorities and evolving requirements.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI-enabled recruitment tools.

**We will place particular emphasis on:**

* **Talent intuition backed by evidence:**
  The ability to spot promising candidates by understanding what they have actually done, not simply what their resumes claim.
* **Independent thinking:**
  The willingness and ability to make reasoned decisions rather than blindly follow templates, keywords, or AI recommendations.
* **High agency:**
  Identifying what needs to be done, taking initiative, and driving it to completion without constant supervision.
* **Learning agility:**
  Converting feedback and mistakes into better screening decisions and stronger recruitment outcomes.
* **Outcome orientation:**
  Caring about the quality of candidates hired, not just the number of resumes sourced or calls completed.
* **Collaborative mindset:**
  Working as a partner to hiring managers and colleagues, sharing insights, and actively seeking feedback.
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Bringing ideas, testing new approaches, and raising the bar on recruitment effectiveness.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates, measured through technical interview progression and hiring manager feedback.
* Screening accuracy, including the ability to identify suitable candidates and reduce avoidable mismatches.
* Improvement in interview-to-shortlist and interview-to-offer conversion rates, with appropriate role-level context.
* Hiring turnaround time and ability to maintain healthy candidate pipelines for priority positions.
* Candidate engagement, interview coordination, and offer conversion.
* Evidence of learning from feedback and sustained improvement in recruitment decisions.
* Proactive recommendations and measurable improvements to recruitment workflows and productivity.

**Why Join Valiance?**

* Work closely with experienced AI, Data Science, and Data Engineering professionals.
* Develop a deeper understanding of emerging technologies and the talent shaping enterprise AI.
* Take ownership of hiring outcomes in a growing deep-tech organization.
* Have the opportunity to influence and improve how a technology company identifies and attracts exceptional talent.

description:
**1. TA Compliance Lead**

We are looking for a TA Compliance lead for one of our clients in Noida.

|

9–12 years |

What are we looking for?

* Exposure to HR and global compliance, including contractual and freelance employees across India and global locations.
* Experience supporting internal and external audits within the GDRC function.
* Familiarity with Darwinbox/Any other tool for recruitment documentation and compliance records.
* ISO 27001 and Six Sigma Green Belt certifications preferred. No specific educational qualification is mandated.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Job Summary

The Process and Compliance Lead for Talent Acquisition is responsible for ensuring

that all recruitment processes, hiring activities, and vendor engagements comply with

internal policies, regulatory requirements, and client-specific compliance standards. This

role plays a critical part in safeguarding the integrity of the hiring lifecycle by conducting

audits, monitoring risks, and ensuring adherence to contractual and regulatory

obligations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**TA Process Management**

 Develop, implement, and maintain Talent Acquisition policies, standard operating

procedures, process maps, templates, and control mechanisms.

 Standardize recruitment practices across teams, projects, locations, and

employment arrangements.

 Ensure compliance with approved workflows, service-level agreements,

authorization requirements, and segregation of duties.

 Monitor the recruitment process and identify areas for improvement.

 Maintain a repository of business processes, workflows, and policies, ensuring

version control and accessibility.

**Legal and Regulatory Compliance**

 Oversee TA compliance with applicable employment, anti-discrimination, data

privacy, records-management, and regulatory requirements.

 Work with Legal, Data Privacy, and HR to ensure recruitment processes meet

legal and company requirements.

 Review job postings, application forms, consent forms, offer templates,

assessment practices, and candidate communications for compliance.

 Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on recruitment policies

and practices.

 Ensure appropriate controls are applied to employees, independent contractors,

agency personnel, and foreign-national hires.

 Escalate matters requiring legal interpretation to authorized Legal or Data

Privacy representatives.

 Ensure recruitment SOPs to align with regulations and client expectations.

 Support client audits and due diligence requests related to hiring practices.

 Validate hiring workflows meet client standards prior to onboarding.

 Monitor third-party vendors to ensure compliance with internal and client

requirements.

**Audit and Risk Management**

 Develop and implement a risk-based TA compliance audit program.

 Conduct periodic reviews of candidate records, hiring decisions, assessments,

approvals, offers, and pre-employment documentation.

 Maintain the TA compliance risk register, audit tracker, and corrective and

preventive action plan.

 Lead the preparation of recruitment records and evidence for internal, external,

client, and regulatory audits.

 Investigate process deviations, identify root causes, and implement preventive

controls.

 Conduct audits of end-to-end recruitment processes to ensure compliance with

company policies, labor laws, and client-defined hiring requirements.

 Review recruitment documentation such as offer letters, contracts, background

checks, and onboarding records for accuracy and compliance.

 Identify compliance risks related to recruitment, data privacy, vendor

management, and SLA adherence.

 Recommend and implement mitigation strategies to minimize risks.

 Prepare and present reports on audit findings, risks, and corrective actions.

 Track compliance KPIs and audit outcomes.

**Candidate Data Privacy and Records Management**

 Ensure that candidate information is collected, accessed, processed, stored,

retained, and disposed of in accordance with company requirements.

 Monitor access controls and the appropriate handling of confidential candidate

information.

 Ensure that required privacy notices, consent forms, and authorizations are in

place.

 Establish recruitment record-retention and document-control procedures.

 Coordinate with IT, Data Privacy, and system owners to address data-security

and system-access concerns.

**Leadership and Coordination**

 Serve as the primary TA contact for recruitment process governance and

compliance matters.

 Provide guidance to recruiters, coordinators, hiring managers, and recruitment

partners.

 Conduct training on recruitment policies and processes.

 Coordinate corrective actions across Talent Acquisition, HR, Legal, Data Privacy,

IT, Operations, and other teams.

 Promote a culture of accountability, ethical recruitment, consistency, and

continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration,

Legal Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

 At least 9 years of relevant experience in Talent Acquisition, recruitment

operations, HR compliance, quality assurance, audit, risk management, or

process improvement.

 At least two years of experience leading projects, processes, or team members is

preferred.

 Strong knowledge of end-to-end recruitment processes, documentation

standards, and control requirements.

 Working knowledge of Philippine employment and data privacy requirements;

exposure to global recruitment compliance is an advantage.

 Experience supporting internal, client, regulatory, or certification audits.

 Experience developing policies, standard operating procedures, process maps,

and compliance reports.

 Proficiency in applicant tracking systems, HR systems, spreadsheets,

dashboards, and reporting tools.

 Compliance, data privacy, quality management, Lean Six Sigma, or internal audit

certification is an advantage.

**Core Competencies**

 Process governance and standardization

 Compliance and risk management

 Audit and quality assurance

 Root-cause analysis

 Policy and procedure development

 Recruitment data privacy and confidentiality

 Leadership and stakeholder management

 Analytical thinking and sound judgment

 Strong attention to detail

 Integrity and accountability

 Change management

 Continuous process improvement

**Key Performance Indicators**

 Recruitment process compliance rate

 Audit pass rate and number of material findings

 Timely closure of corrective and preventive actions

 Candidate-record completeness and accuracy

 Reduction in recurring process deviations

 Compliance with approval and documentation requirements

 Timeliness of policy and procedure updates

 Completion rate of compliance training

 Vendor and agency compliance rate

 Data privacy and records-retention compliance

 Process-improvement initiatives completed

 Audit readiness and timely submission of evidence

Role Boundary

The TA Process and Compliance Lead ensures that legal and regulatory requirements

are incorporated into recruitment processes but does not provide independent legal

advice. Matters requiring formal legal interpretation must be referred to the company’s

Legal, Data Privacy, or authorized external counsel.

description:

**Company:**
Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Industry:**
AI / Deep Tech / SaaS / Technology

About Zynence

Zynence is building an AI-native, full-lifecycle hardware engineering platform designed to transform how physical products are conceptualized, designed, developed, validated, and manufactured. Our platform brings together requirements engineering, system architecture, BOM and cost optimization, electronics and PCB design, firmware development, AI-native 3D CAD, simulation, validation, and manufacturing readiness within a connected, intelligent engineering environment.

We are an early-stage deep-tech startup with ambitious plans to build a globally scalable engineering technology company. As our team grows, we are looking for an HR Generalist who can take ownership of our people operations, build scalable HR processes, and help us attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and execution-oriented
**HR Generalist**
to independently manage day-to-day HR functions while helping establish the people infrastructure of a growing technology startup.

This is a hands-on role involving recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR operations, policy implementation, performance management coordination, and statutory compliance support.

You will work directly with the founders and functional teams, taking ownership of HR activities from workforce planning and talent acquisition to employee lifecycle management and organizational development.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in an early-stage environment, can build processes from scratch, and understands that effective HR is about enabling people and business growth—not simply managing documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for technical, product, business, and operational roles.
* Collaborate with founders and hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define job descriptions, and establish candidate evaluation criteria.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, referrals, campus networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen applications, conduct initial HR interviews, and coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Maintain structured candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and applicant databases.
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer negotiations, reference checks, and joining formalities.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines for upcoming hiring requirements.
* Build relationships with colleges, universities, and training institutions for internships, fellowships, and campus recruitment.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, interview conversion, and offer acceptance rates.

2. Employee Onboarding & Lifecycle Management

* Own the complete employee onboarding process, from offer acceptance through joining and initial integration.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, and onboarding documentation.
* Coordinate employee verification, system access, induction schedules, and departmental introductions.
* Conduct structured onboarding sessions covering company policies, processes, and expectations.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Manage employee confirmations, transfers, role changes, and other lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate employee exits, clearance procedures, exit interviews, and full-and-final settlement documentation.

3. HR Operations & Administration

* Establish and maintain standardized HR processes, documentation, trackers, and operating procedures.
* Manage employee attendance, leave records, holidays, and related HR administration.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, and compensation changes.
* Maintain employee databases and HR management systems.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment-related documents.
* Support workforce planning, headcount tracking, and HR reporting.
* Coordinate with finance, administration, and external consultants on HR-related matters.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities and improve operational efficiency.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**SENIOR HR MANAGER – MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS**

**Tributum Power Private Limited**

*An Accel1 Inc. Joint Venture | AtmosPOLE™ Manufacturing & Assembly*

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Onsite)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Administration

**Experience:**
Minimum 15 Years

**Qualification:**
MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management or Industrial Relations

**Reporting To:**
JV CEO / Senior Management

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Industry:**
Climate Engineering | Intelligent Infrastructure | Advanced Manufacturing

**ABOUT TRIBUTUM POWER**

**Tributum Power Private Limited is a joint venture of Accel1 Inc.**
, established to manufacture, assemble, deploy and scale AtmosPOLE™, Accel1's flagship intelligent environmental infrastructure platform.

AtmosPOLE™ integrates environmental monitoring, air treatment, smart lighting, IoT connectivity, digital communication, public safety and AI-powered environmental intelligence into multifunctional urban infrastructure.

Tributum Power is establishing advanced manufacturing and assembly capabilities to support large-scale deployment of intelligent climate infrastructure.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on
**Senior HR Manager with 15+ years of experience**
to establish and lead the Human Resources and Administration function for our manufacturing operations in Noida.

The selected candidate will build HR operations from the ground up, recruit approximately
**48 manufacturing and operational professionals**
, establish HR policies, implement digital systems, manage statutory compliance and develop a high-performance organizational culture.

The role requires strong expertise in manufacturing recruitment, industrial relations, workforce planning, payroll, performance management and employee development.

**We seek an HR leader who can build an organization, not simply manage an existing department.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. HR Strategy & Organization Building**

* Establish the HR and Administration function, organizational structure, policies and procedures.
* Develop scalable HR systems aligned with manufacturing growth.
* Define employee grades, compensation structures and reporting hierarchies.
* Advise senior management on workforce strategy and organizational development.
* Build a culture of accountability, safety, productivity and operational excellence.

**2. Workforce Planning & Recruitment**

* Lead recruitment and onboarding for approximately 48 manufacturing and operational positions.
* Recruit engineers, production managers, mechanical/electrical technicians, electronics and IoT specialists, QA/QC personnel, supervisors and administrative staff.
* Develop manpower plans, recruitment budgets and hiring schedules.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, technical assessments and offers.
* Build partnerships with ITIs, polytechnics, engineering colleges and recruitment agencies.
* Develop talent pipelines across Noida, Greater Noida and Delhi NCR.
* Monitor recruitment timelines, costs, offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Plan future staffing requirements for manufacturing expansion.

**3. HR Policies & Employee Administration**

* Develop employee handbooks, HR policies, appointment letters and employment agreements.
* Establish attendance, leave, shift, overtime, holiday and disciplinary policies.
* Implement onboarding, probation, confirmation, appraisal and exit processes.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation and administrative controls.
* Ensure consistent HR policy implementation across departments.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Industrial Relations**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and Uttar Pradesh labor laws and employment regulations.
* Manage applicable EPF, ESI, gratuity, minimum wages, overtime and statutory benefits.
* Maintain factory-related employment records, statutory registers and compliance documentation.
* Oversee applicable contract labor, apprenticeship and outsourced workforce requirements.
* Establish grievance, disciplinary, employee welfare and workplace harassment prevention procedures.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, labor consultants, auditors and government authorities.
* Resolve employee disputes and maintain compliance calendars.

**5. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies and employee benefits.
* Coordinate payroll, attendance reconciliation, overtime, statutory deductions and settlements.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing with Finance.
* Develop increments, incentives and employee recognition programs.
* Prepare manpower budgets and compensation reports.

**6. Performance Management & Development**

* Establish performance appraisal systems and role-specific KRAs/KPIs.
* Implement probation reviews, evaluations and performance improvement plans.
* Develop performance-linked incentives and recognition programs.
* Support promotions, career progression and leadership development.
* Partner with department heads to improve productivity and accountability.

**7. Training & Technical Skills**

* Establish induction, orientation and employee development programs.
* Coordinate training in mechanical assembly, electrical systems, electronics, IoT and quality control.
* Develop competency matrices with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and EHS teams.
* Coordinate safety awareness and workplace training.
* Maintain training records and develop institutional skill-development partnerships.

**8. Employee Relations & Retention**

* Build a professional, inclusive and performance-oriented workplace.
* Establish grievance-resolution and employee communication processes.
* Develop engagement, welfare, recognition and retention programs.
* Conduct employee feedback sessions and exit interviews.
* Monitor attrition, absenteeism and workplace satisfaction.

**9. Manufacturing HR & Shop-Floor Operations**

* Work closely with Production Managers, Supervisors and Engineering leadership.
* Establish shift-wise manpower planning and workforce allocation.
* Monitor attendance, overtime and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate technical staffing based on production requirements.
* Support production ramp-up, workforce readiness and operational expansion.
* Reinforce workplace discipline, safety and quality expectations.

**10. HRMS, Digital Systems & Analytics**

* Implement HRMS and biometric attendance systems.
* Digitize recruitment, onboarding, employee records, payroll and performance management.
* Develop dashboards for headcount, recruitment, attrition, payroll, training and compliance.
* Ensure employee data confidentiality and reporting accuracy.
* Present HR analytics and management reports.

**11. Administration, Budgeting & Leadership**

* Oversee assigned factory and office administration and employee facilities.
* Coordinate workplace welfare and safety induction with EHS personnel.
* Prepare HR budgets, manpower forecasts and training plans.
* Report recruitment progress, compliance and workforce costs.
* Build and mentor the HR team as operations expand.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations or related discipline.
* **Minimum 15 years of HR experience**
  , preferably in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven experience establishing or scaling HR functions.
* Strong technical recruitment and industrial workforce planning capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial relations, payroll and compliance.
* Experience implementing HR policies, HRMS an

**FIRST 90 DAYS – EXPECTED DELIVERABLES**

**Days 1–30: Establish**

* Finalize manpower plans and recruitment priorities.
* Establish essential HR policies, documentation and onboarding processes.
* Begin hiring critical manufacturing and technical personnel.
* Assess statutory compliance, payroll and HRMS requirements.

**Days 31–60: Mobilize**

* Accelerate recruitment against agreed staffing milestones.
* Implement employee records, attendance and payroll coordination.
* Establish induction, safety awareness and training programs.
* Introduce HR dashboards, compliance tracking and departmental KPIs.

**Days 61–90: Operationalize**

* Progress toward completion of the initial recruitment plan.
* Stabilize HR administration, payroll and employee relations.
* Implement employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Conduct an initial compliance assessment.
* Present a scalable HR roadmap for future expansion.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Success will be measured through recruitment completion, time to hire, workforce readiness, employee retention, statutory compliance, payroll accuracy, training completion, KRA/KPI implementation, HRMS adoption, employee engagement and manpower budget adherence.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated résumé to
**careers@accel1.com**
with the subject line:

**Application – Senior HR Manager – Tributum Power**

Please include your current designation, total HR and manufacturing experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

*Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H)*
**Tower**
Recruit to Hire (R2H)
  
  
**Location**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)
  
  
**Reports to**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida
  
  
**Role type**
People manager
  
  
**Scope**
Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding
  
  
**Grade**
As per BV grading framework
  
  
****ABOUT THE HUB****
Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.
  
  
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Transition and shared services set-up
* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.
* Process ownership and service delivery
* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

****WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE****

* First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed.
* By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries.
* Within 12–18 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
**KPI**
**Indicative target**
**Time to offer / time to fill**
Reduced against the country baseline
  
  
**Offer TAT**
≥ 95%
  
  
**Candidate NPS**
≥ +40
  
  
**Hiring manager satisfaction**
≥ 4.3 / 5
  
  
**Day-one readiness**
≥ 98% of joiners fully set up
  
  
**Vendor SLA adherence**
≥ 95%
  
  
**Cost per hire**
Reduced against baseline
  
  
*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*
****TECHNICAL SKILLS****

* End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring.
* Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers.
* ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar).
* Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics.
* Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data.
* Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**
Customer-centric leadership
  
  

* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

****Essential****
**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations.
* Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model.
* Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

****Preferred****

* Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Experience deploying AI recruitment tools

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT.

title: Senior Manager - Human Resources
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Senior Manager - Human Resources**
Location - Noida
  
  
**Profile Summary**
The Senior Manager - Human Resources will be responsible for driving the organization's talent acquisition strategy, compensation philosophy, rewards framework, incentive programs and employee development journeys. The role will ensure the attraction, engagement, development and retention of high-performing talent while aligning people practices with business objectives and organizational growth plans.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement talent acquisition strategies aligned with business growth plans and workforce requirements.
* Lead end-to-end recruitment for leadership, managerial and critical business positions.
* Partner with business leaders to understand manpower requirements and workforce planning needs.
* Build robust talent pipelines through consultants, job portals, social media, professional networks, employee referrals and campus hiring initiatives.
* Drive employer branding initiatives to position the organization as an employer of choice.
* Establish and monitor recruitment metrics including time to fill, quality of hire, offer acceptance rate and hiring cost.
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience across the recruitment lifecycle.
* Conduct talent mapping and succession pipeline identification for critical positions.
* Develop and implement compensation strategies to ensure market competitiveness and internal equity.
* Lead salary benchmarking studies and recommend compensation structures based on external market trends.
* Design and drive annual compensation review, salary increment and promotion processes.
* Establish job evaluation and grading frameworks to support career progression and organizational effectiveness.
* Partner with business leaders and finance teams on workforce cost planning and compensation budgeting.
* Ensure governance, consistency and compliance across all compensation-related practices.
* Design and implement rewards and recognition programs to reinforce high performance and desired workplace behaviors.
* Develop recognition initiatives including spot awards, long-service awards, achievement awards and performance recognition programs.
* Drive employee engagement through innovative reward and recognition practices.
* Monitor effectiveness of rewards programs and recommend continuous improvements.
* Design and manage short-term and long-term incentive programs aligned with business objectives.
* Develop performance-linked incentive structures for sales, manufacturing and corporate functions.
* Evaluate incentive effectiveness and recommend enhancements based on business outcomes and employee feedback.
* Ensure incentive plans drive accountability, productivity and organizational performance.
* Design structured employee development journeys across functions and career levels.
* Develop competency frameworks, career progression models and capability development roadmaps.
* Create leadership development programs for high-potential and future leaders.
* Support succession planning through targeted development interventions and talent readiness programs.
* Partner with business leaders to identify current and future capability requirements.
* Establish learning pathways to strengthen technical, functional and leadership competencies.
* Monitor effectiveness of development initiatives through internal movement, promotion readiness and succession strength metrics.
* Act as a strategic advisor to leadership teams on talent acquisition, compensation, rewards and development-related decisions.
* Utilize HR analytics and insights to drive data-based talent and rewards decisions.
* Drive automation, process improvement and digital transformation initiatives within Talent Acquisition and Rewards functions.
* Lead, coach and develop team members to build a high-performing HR function.

**Educational Qualification**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred.

**Experience**

* 10-14 years of progressive HR experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, renewable energy, industrial, engineering or large corporate organizations preferred.
* Strong exposure to leadership hiring and strategic HR initiatives.

**Work Experience**
**Core Competencies**

* Talent Acquisition Strategy
* Leadership Hiring
* Workforce Planning
* Compensation Strategy
* Rewards & Recognition
* Incentive Design & Management
* Employee Development Journeys
* Talent Management
* Career Architecture
* Succession Planning
* Employer Branding
* HR Analytics
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management
* Project Management
* Team Leadership

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**HR Executive**

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
1-3 years

**About the Company**

TheHireHub.AI is transforming recruitment through intelligent technology that helps organizations discover, evaluate, engage, and hire talent more efficiently. Founded by experienced executive-search professionals, the company combines deep hiring expertise with AI-driven workflows designed for the realities of modern recruitment. Its platform supports sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and coordination, helping recruitment teams spend less time on administration and more time making strategic decisions. TheHireHub.AI serves mid-market and growth-stage businesses across India, APAC, and MEA, while building a growing global presence. Insights from more than 3,000 global hiring projects inform the company’s approach to creating practical, scalable recruitment solutions. Headquartered in Gurugram, the organization operates with a focused team and a strong culture of innovation, efficiency, and empowerment. Its mission is to make hiring faster and smarter, while its vision is to reshape recruitment through AI-enabled experiences. The company is committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace where people can take ownership, learn continuously, and contribute to meaningful improvements in the way teams and talent connect.

**About the Role**

The HR Analyst will support recruitment and core people operations by maintaining accurate data, coordinating hiring workflows, and turning HR information into useful insights. The role owns the reliability of candidate and employee records, recruitment reporting, interview coordination, and timely stakeholder communication. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and internal teams to keep hiring activity organized and measurable. Success means improving process visibility, reducing coordination delays, and helping the organization make consistent, data-informed people decisions. This opportunity requires 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment experience and suits someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, organized, and motivated to build a career in HR within an AI-enabled talent technology company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate candidate and employee information in HR and recruitment systems, improving data quality and ensuring stakeholders can rely on current records for timely hiring decisions.
* Coordinate recruitment workflows from candidate screening through interview scheduling and follow-up, reducing delays and creating a consistent experience for candidates and hiring teams.
* Prepare regular recruitment and HR reports covering pipeline movement, interview status, hiring activity, and process trends, enabling managers to identify bottlenecks and prioritize action.
* Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to track open roles, clarify requirements, and maintain visibility into progress, improving accountability across the hiring process.
* Support sourcing, screening, and candidate communication activities while maintaining professional, timely engagement that strengthens the organization’s ability to attract qualified talent.
* Identify recurring process gaps in recruitment administration and recommend practical improvements, helping the HR function scale with greater consistency and operational efficiency.
* Protect confidential candidate and employee information by following approved processes, maintaining documentation discipline, and escalating data or compliance concerns promptly.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Mandatory: 1–3 years of hands-on recruitment experience, including candidate coordination, screening support, interview scheduling, and follow-up across multiple hiring stages.
* Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and HR or applicant-tracking systems, with the ability to maintain accurate records, organize data, and prepare clear operational reports.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining reliable service for candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Basic understanding of recruitment metrics and HR operations, with a practical mindset for identifying trends, resolving process issues, and improving workflow visibility.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, technology-led environment while collaborating effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams.

**Additional Plus**

* Exposure to recruitment analytics, dashboards, or reporting automation that has helped improve pipeline visibility or hiring decisions.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled recruitment platforms, talent marketplaces, or HR technology workflows and an interest in how technology can improve access to opportunity.
* Experience supporting employer branding, candidate engagement, onboarding coordination, or other people operations activities beyond core recruitment administration.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring the mandatory 1–3 years of practical recruitment experience and a genuine interest in building a broader HR career. You are organized, dependable, and comfortable owning details that directly affect candidate and stakeholder experience.
* You can manage interview schedules, follow up consistently, maintain accurate records, and keep multiple hiring activities moving without losing quality. You use spreadsheets and systems confidently, understand the importance of clean data, and can turn routine recruitment information into clear updates or useful reports.
* You communicate professionally with candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers, adapting your style while keeping expectations clear. You are curious about process improvement and willing to question inefficient ways of working when a better solution is possible.
* You handle confidential information responsibly and understand that trust is central to HR operations. Most importantly, you are comfortable learning in a growing organization, taking ownership of outcomes, and contributing to a collaborative, inclusive environment where recruitment technology and human judgment work together to improve how people find opportunity.

**Why Join Us**

* Help build the people operations foundation of a global talent technology company, with direct exposure to recruitment, HR analytics, and AI-enabled hiring workflows.
* Work alongside teams improving how employers and candidates connect, giving you a practical opportunity to influence more accessible and merit-driven employment outcomes.
* Grow in a collaborative, fast-moving environment that values ownership, continuous learning, inclusive teamwork, and measurable improvements to everyday recruitment operations.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful exposure to recruitment operations, HR analytics, talent marketplaces, and AI-powered hiring automation within a growing technology company.
* An inclusive, merit-driven working environment where your ideas, analysis, and process improvements can directly influence team effectiveness and candidate experience.
* Opportunities to learn from cross-functional collaboration with recruiters, hiring managers, and technology teams while developing a strong foundation for a long-term HR career.

**About LoansJagat**

LoansJagat is a technology-driven lending marketplace focused on simplifying access to credit by connecting customers with relevant financial solutions. As we continue to scale our business, we are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Manager who can build strong hiring capabilities and support the organisation's growth through effective talent strategies.

**Job Purpose**

The Talent Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the end-to-end recruitment function, driving hiring strategy across business and corporate functions, managing recruitment teams, and partnering closely with business leaders to ensure timely and quality hiring.

The role requires strong expertise in
**bulk hiring, lateral hiring, leadership hiring, talent sourcing, recruitment operations, and stakeholder management**
, along with the ability to build scalable and efficient hiring processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition Strategy**

* Develop and execute the annual and monthly talent acquisition strategy aligned with business requirements.
* Own hiring plans, recruitment targets, timelines, and manpower requirements across functions.
* Build effective sourcing strategies for both volume and specialised hiring.
* Ensure timely closure of critical and business-sensitive positions.
* Identify opportunities to improve hiring efficiency, quality, and turnaround time.

**2. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage the Talent Acquisition team, including recruiters and sourcing specialists.
* Set individual and team-wise hiring targets and monitor performance.
* Coach the team on sourcing, screening, interviewing, negotiation, and candidate closure.
* Build a performance-driven recruitment culture with clear accountability.
* Support hiring and development of the TA team as the organisation scales.

**3. Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with founders, business heads, department leaders, and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements.
* Drive regular hiring reviews and provide visibility on open positions, pipeline, closures, and challenges.
* Ensure clear understanding of JDs, candidate expectations, compensation benchmarks, and hiring timelines.
* Act as a strategic recruitment partner to business leaders.

**4. Sourcing & Hiring**

* Drive end-to-end recruitment across sales, operations, technology, product, finance, HR, and other corporate functions.
* Develop strong sourcing channels through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, agencies, networking, and direct sourcing.
* Lead bulk and volume hiring initiatives while maintaining quality of hire.
* Handle critical and senior-level positions independently.
* Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for recurring and niche requirements.

**5. Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence**

* Establish and maintain structured recruitment processes from requisition to onboarding.
* Monitor key recruitment metrics including
  **Time to Hire, Time to Fill, Cost per Hire, Source Effectiveness, Offer-to-Join Ratio, and Quality of Hire**
  .
* Maintain accurate recruitment MIS and provide regular hiring reports to leadership.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to enhance recruiter productivity and candidate experience.
* Ensure adherence to defined recruitment policies and processes.

**6. Employer Branding & Candidate Experience**

* Strengthen the organisation's employer brand across relevant hiring platforms and professional networks.
* Partner with HR and business teams to improve candidate engagement and overall hiring experience.
* Support recruitment campaigns, employee referral initiatives, campus hiring, and other talent attraction programs.
* Build a strong talent pipeline and market presence for the organisation.

**7. Vendor & Recruitment Partner Management**

* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, consultants, job portals, and other hiring partners.
* Evaluate vendor performance based on quality, turnaround time, and closure ratio.
* Negotiate and manage recruitment partner commercials where required.
* Ensure external hiring partners adhere to organisational recruitment standards.

**Key Requirements**

* **Mandatory 9–10 years of proven experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**
  , preferably within Fintech, BFSI, Lending, E-commerce, Technology, or other high-growth organisations.
* Strong experience in managing both
  **bulk hiring and lateral hiring**
  .
* Prior experience in managing a Talent Acquisition team.
* Strong exposure to sales and volume hiring will be an added advantage.
* Experience in handling mid-to-senior-level and critical hiring mandates.
* Strong understanding of sourcing channels, recruitment tools, market mapping, and talent intelligence.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical ability with hands-on experience in recruitment MIS and hiring metrics.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Strong negotiation, candidate management, and closure skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple hiring priorities and deliver within defined timelines.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Hiring target achievement
* Time to Fill / Time to Hire
* Offer-to-Joining Ratio
* Quality of Hire
* Source-wise conversion and effectiveness
* Recruiter productivity
* Cost per Hire
* Critical position closure
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Employee retention / early attrition of new hires

**Ideal Candidate**

A strong understanding of
**volume hiring, business hiring, market mapping, recruitment analytics, and talent strategy**
is essential. The person should be able to build a scalable TA function while ensuring speed, quality, and a strong candidate experience.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Plant HR – Manufacturing Operations**

**Company:**
Amitoje India Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Position:**
Plant HR / Factory HR

**Experience Required:**
4–7 Years

**Industry:**
Manufacturing / Printing / Fabrication / Packaging

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Work from Office

(THIS IS AN IMMEDIATE JOINING)

**About Amitoje India**

Amitoje India Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing company specializing in innovative retail display solutions, branding, printing, and fabrication. We operate in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where workforce efficiency, operational discipline, and timely execution are critical.

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on
**Plant HR professional**
who can independently manage HR operations at our Noida manufacturing facility, with a strong focus on blue-collar workforce management, recruitment, statutory compliance, and employee relations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Blue-Collar Recruitment & Workforce Planning**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment of factory workers, machine operators, helpers, technicians, supervisors, and other production personnel.
* Develop reliable recruitment channels through contractors, local references, manpower agencies, and direct hiring.
* Ensure timely availability of manpower according to production requirements.
* Maintain a database of potential candidates for urgent manpower requirements.
* Reduce recruitment turnaround time and workforce attrition.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and joining formalities.

**2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management**

* Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late arrivals, overtime, and shift schedules.
* Ensure accurate attendance records through biometric systems and HRMS.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, deductions, incentives, and leave.
* Maintain employee records and ensure timely resolution of salary-related queries.
* Track absenteeism and implement corrective measures to improve workforce availability.
* Coordinate with production supervisors to ensure adequate manpower across shifts.

**3. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for factory employees.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary issues, and worker concerns.
* Maintain a positive and productive relationship between workers, supervisors, and management.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Address issues related to employee misconduct, absenteeism, and workplace behaviour through fair and documented processes.

**4. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate records relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages, overtime, and other statutory obligations.
* Coordinate with compliance consultants and government authorities whenever required.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and records required for inspections and audits.
* Ensure labour contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Support implementation of applicable occupational health, safety, and welfare requirements.

**5. Factory Discipline & HR Administration**

* Ensure adherence to factory rules, reporting timings, shift schedules, and workplace policies.
* Conduct regular shop-floor visits to understand workforce concerns and monitor discipline.
* Coordinate with production managers and supervisors on manpower utilization and productivity.
* Monitor employee movement, unauthorized absenteeism, and workplace conduct.
* Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Support smooth employee exits, handovers, and Full & Final Settlements.

**6. Contractor & Manpower Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractual manpower deployment, attendance, and performance.
* Verify contractor bills against approved attendance and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure availability of backup manpower during peak production periods.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.

**7. Performance Management & HR Reporting**

* Coordinate performance reviews for factory employees and supervisors.
* Identify recurring attendance, productivity, and behavioural concerns.
* Maintain HR dashboards covering manpower strength, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, and recruitment.
* Share daily and weekly manpower reports with management.
* Support initiatives to improve employee retention, discipline, and workforce productivity.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in HR or a related qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant.
* Strong experience handling blue-collar and contractual workforces.
* Practical understanding of factory HR operations and labour law compliance.
* Experience in printing, packaging, fabrication, engineering, or similar manufacturing industries will be preferred.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong blue-collar recruitment capabilities.
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and labour compliance.
* Experience managing factory attendance, overtime, and payroll coordination.
* Strong interpersonal skills and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and attendance management systems.
* Good communication skills in Hindi and working knowledge of English.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Plant HR will be evaluated on:

1. **Manpower Availability:**
   Ensuring adequate workforce availability as per production requirements.
2. **Recruitment TAT:**
   Timely closure of blue-collar and factory-level vacancies.
3. **Attendance & Absenteeism:**
   Improvement in workforce attendance and reduction in unplanned absenteeism.
4. **Employee Retention:**
   Reduction in avoidable blue-collar attrition.
5. **Payroll Accuracy:**
   Accurate and timely submission of payroll inputs.
6. **Statutory Compliance:**
   Timely compliance with applicable labour laws and documentation requirements.
7. **Factory Discipline:**
   Effective management of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.
8. **HR Reporting:**
   Timely and accurate submission of manpower and HR reports.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is
**not limited to desk-based HR operations**
.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, interacting directly with workers, resolving workforce issues, and coordinating closely with production teams.

The candidate must be resourceful, firm yet approachable, and capable of maintaining workforce discipline while ensuring fair treatment of employees.

**Most importantly, the person should take complete ownership of plant-level HR operations rather than depending on constant supervision.**
