title: MSP Program Specialist
description:
***Company Overview:***

*Workspend is a leading global provider of contingent workforce management solutions for Fortune 500/Global 2000 clients. Workspend is one of the fastest growing companies in the industry and currently supports over 40 clients to manage their temporary workforce and total talent solutions. Workspend is an innovative company, and we are using the latest innovative technologies to disrupt the workforce industry.*

**Job Summary:**

The Program Specialist is responsible for supporting temporary/contingent workforce programs for our clients. The Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with Hiring Managers and suppliers to support and manage the full lifecycle for the requisition process including requisition intake, shortlisting, Supplier sourcing management, onboarding, worker assignment management, time and expense, offboarding and reporting. The Program Specialist acts as a talent advisor and strategic business partner to support our clients and ensure requisition fulfillment for quality talent in a timely manner. The role offers an excellent opportunity for someone to learn strong leadership skills and grow in their careers

**Responsibilities:**

* Managing hiring manager relationships and at times interacting with client’s executive leadership to ensure all contingent labor needs are fulfilled.
* Managing the staffing and requisition fulfillment process – ensuring that the client’s needs are being met. Including, but not limited to: Assisting client managers during all stages of the contract labor acquisition process including: requisition intake, sourcing, candidate shortlisting and interviewing
* Document requirement intake conversations in appropriate database (VMS etc.)
* Discuss with HM agree upon expectations, timeframes, feedback, roles and responsibilities of everyone involved in the requisition fulfilment process
* Work with and communicate with staffing suppliers to make sure that proper feedback, projections, and critical communications are being relayed in a timely manner.
* Facilitation of on-boarding and off-boarding of contractors
* Maintain the VMS (vendor management system) with strong attention to details of staffing, hiring and on boarding process of the contingent workforce. This will include updating the system with rate changes, processing contract extensions, processing releases/terminations and updating other data as necessary.
* Work to identify new opportunities to expand client relationships by partnering with the delivery teams to provide proactive solutions to current and future challenges.
* Provide strong professional management of the contingent workforce to include, but not limited to, interviewing, screening, selection/deselection, orientation, supervision, coaching, counseling, and disciplinary actions up to and including releases/terminations based on client guidelines.
* Coach, manage and oversee performance of participating staffing suppliers
* Document all client/supplier reported issues and track resolution through to completion ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
* Conduct supplier scorecard reviews, including performance discussions, metric adherence and strategic conversations
* Accurate and on-time completion of reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Conduct new hire orientation with all prospective candidates per customer guidelines.
* Conduct regular meetings with the customer managers to ensure effective communication.
* Monitor and address issues and concerns with the contingent workforce quickly and effectively; escalate issues to management as needed.
* Assist with development of presentation and customer facing items (QBRs, Operational reviews, Dashboard reviews, other), with support from leader
* Assist with worker assignment management (cost center changes, extension of contract assignments etc.) to improve data integrity
* Liaison with managers, vendors and security department to ensure all necessary paperwork is completed and collected prior to starting assignments and at end of assignments
* Ensure all work orders are closed in the system with accurate finish reasons when notified of an end of assignment and appropriate departments are notified (i.e., security)
* Assist with the collection of company assets from vendors (laptop, badges, etc.)
* Work hand in hand with the program management team to ensure metrics, SLAs, and targets are driven with a vision and are being met.
* Serve as the professional representative of Workspend to the client – solving problems and diligently following up to ensure best in class service to the client.
* Work with the client to help identify departments, skill set categories, divisions and locations where Workspend’ s services could assist in cost savings, risk aversion and efficiencies.
* Participate in client meetings to review strategic initiatives and assist with PMO roadmap/initiatives

**Mandatory skills:**

* Minimum 2-3 years’ experience supporting clients for their temporary workforce hiring and management either for a temp/contingent staffing MSP or a temp staffing master vendor program.
* Experience in high volume coordination activities (interviewing, on-boarding, etc.)
* Experience with MS Office (Excel, Word, PPT) and PC skills
* Able to work independently with minimal direction required for core daily responsibilities
* Medium level of direction needed for advanced responsibilities
* Excellent communication skills including client relationship management
* Detail oriented with strong analytical skills
* Should be a quick learner and motivation to continue to grow in your career.
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent business experience preferred.
* Ability to travel as needed
* Customer Focused

**Education/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 3-4 years of relevant experience.

*Workspend is an EEOE. Workspend offers an entrepreneurial culture and endless opportunity to grow for the right and motivated individuals. Looking for candidates who are driven and are looking to grow to next level in their careers. Should be responsible and take ownership.*

*Workspend offers an attractive compensation package and benefits that include health Insurance, flexible paid time off and other benefits.*

* Work with and communicate with staffing suppliers to make sure that proper feedback, projections, and critical communications are being relayed in a timely manner.
* Facilitation of on-boarding and off-boarding of contractors
* Maintain the VMS (vendor management system) with strong attention to details of staffing, hiring and on boarding process of the contingent workforce. This will include updating the system with rate changes, processing contract extensions, processing releases/terminations and updating other data as necessary.
* Work to identify new opportunities to expand client relationships by partnering with the delivery teams to provide proactive solutions to current and future challenges.
* Provide strong professional management of the contingent workforce to include, but not limited to, interviewing, screening, selection/deselection, orientation, supervision, coaching, counseling, and disciplinary actions up to and including releases/terminations based on client guidelines.
* Coach, manage and oversee performance of participating staffing suppliers
* Document all client/supplier reported issues and track resolution through to completion ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
* Conduct supplier scorecard reviews, including performance discussions, metric adherence and strategic conversations
* Accurate and on-time completion of reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Conduct new hire orientation with all prospective candidates per customer guidelines.
* Conduct regular meetings with the customer managers to ensure effective communication.
* Monitor and address issues and concerns with the contingent workforce quickly and effectively; escalate issues to management as needed.
* Assist with development of presentation and customer-facing items (QBRs, Operational reviews, Dashboard reviews, other), with support from leader
* Assist with worker assignment management (cost center changes, extension of contract assignments etc.) to improve data integrity
* Liaison with managers, vendors and security department to ensure all necessary paperwork is completed and collected prior to starting assignments and at end of assignments
* Ensure all work orders are closed in the system with accurate finish reasons when notified of an end of assignment and appropriate departments are notified (i.e., security)
* Assist with the collection of company assets from vendors (laptop, badges, etc.)
* Work hand in hand with the program management team to ensure metrics, SLAs, and targets are driven with a vision and are being met.
* Serve as the professional representative of Workspend to the client – solving problems and diligently following up to ensure best in class service to the client.
* Work with the client to help identify departments, skill set categories, divisions and locations where Workspend’ s services could assist in cost savings, risk aversion and efficiencies.
* Participate in client meetings to review strategic initiatives and assist with PMO roadmap/initiatives

**Mandatory skills:**

* Minimum 1-2 years’ experience supporting clients for their temporary workforce hiring and management either for a temp/contingent staffing MSP or a temp staffing master vendor program.
* Experience in high volume coordination activities (interviewing, onboarding, etc.)
* Experience with MS Office (Excel, Word, PPT) and PC skills
* Able to work independently with minimal direction required for core daily responsibilities
* Medium level of direction needed for advanced responsibilities
* Excellent communication skills including client relationship management
* Detail oriented with strong analytical skills
* Should be a quick learner and motivation to continue to grow in your career.
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent business experience preferred.
* Customer Focused

*Workspend is an EEOE. Workspend offers an entrepreneurial culture and endless opportunity to grow for the right and motivated individuals. Looking for candidates who are driven and are looking to grow to next level in their careers. Should be responsible and take ownership. Workspend offers an attractive compensation package and benefits that include health Insurance, flexible paid time off and other benefits.*

Job Title
 
  
 


 About the Role
 
  
 


 Tenure \-  4 month contractual role
 
  
 


 Introduction
 
 Oxford University Press is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders, helping to shape workforce decisions through market insight, recruitment expertise, and a deep understanding of the organisation's talent needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced recruitment professional who enjoys influencing stakeholders, building talent strategies, and delivering exceptional candidate experiences.
 



 As part of the Group HR function, you will play a critical role in attracting and securing high\-quality talent that supports OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning. You will build strong partnerships across the business, proactively develop talent pipelines, and create innovative attraction strategies that support both immediate and long\-term hiring requirements.
 



 This role provides broad exposure across all aspects of talent acquisition, including sourcing strategy, stakeholder partnering, recruitment operations, employer branding, diversity and inclusion, recruitment process improvement, and market intelligence. It offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on organisational growth while working in a collaborative and globally connected HR environment.
 


   Opportunity
 
 As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues, suppliers, and candidates to deliver a high\-quality recruitment experience.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Partnering with hiring managers and HR business partners to source and attract outstanding talent in line with organisational design and reward principles.
* Developing recruitment plans for hiring managers using data, market intelligence, sourcing insights, and cost considerations to support informed hiring decisions.
* Building long\-term relationships with business stakeholders to understand immediate and future workforce requirements.
* Creating and implementing attraction strategies and talent pipelines to support business objectives and workforce planning.
* Proactively seeking market intelligence and candidate insights to build high\-quality talent pools.
* Engaging with potential candidates through direct sourcing, networking, recruitment events, social media platforms, and talent communities.
* Working towards direct hiring objectives and reducing dependency on external agencies wherever appropriate.
* Coaching hiring managers through every stage of the end\-to\-end recruitment process.
* Advising managers on effective assessment and selection methods to identify the best candidates.
* Championing diversity and inclusion throughout the recruitment process and supporting diverse shortlists.
* Promoting awareness of unconscious bias and inclusive hiring practices among hiring managers.
* Keeping up to date with recruitment legislation and communicating relevant updates to hiring managers and HR stakeholders.
* Delivering coaching sessions, briefings, and guidance on recruitment policies, legal requirements, and best practices.
* Managing recruitment operations to ensure candidates are assessed, selected, offered, vetted, and onboarded in accordance with OUP policies and procedures.
* Managing preferred supplier relationships and ensuring agencies remain compliant, effective, and aligned with OUP's values and requirements.
* Collaborating with HR Operations and wider HR teams to ensure recruitment processes and systems are efficient and effective.
* Driving continuous improvement within recruitment processes through training, feedback, process enhancement, and knowledge sharing initiatives.
* Delivering recruitment system and process training to hiring managers and stakeholders.
* Ensuring Information Security and Data Privacy requirements are maintained throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Implementing appropriate controls to mitigate data privacy risks and ensure responsible handling of candidate information.
* Working cross\-functionally with colleagues across HR services, operations, projects, and change initiatives to support business objectives and organisational alignment.
* Supporting additional projects and duties that contribute to OUP's wider mission and operational goals.


   Impact
 
 This role is central to OUP's ability to attract, engage, and retain outstanding talent. By providing expert recruitment guidance, building strong talent pipelines, supporting inclusive hiring practices, and delivering an excellent candidate experience, you will directly contribute to the organisation's success and future growth. Your work will strengthen workforce capability, support business performance, and enhance OUP's reputation as an employer of choice.
 


   About You   Essential Criteria
 * Previous agency and/or in\-house recruitment experience.
* Experience managing high\-volume end\-to\-end recruitment processes.
* Proven ability to directly source candidates through a variety of channels.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Experience using multiple sourcing, screening, and assessment tools.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage a varied workload.
* Experience working collaboratively within team environments.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to analyse market information and use data to inform recruitment decisions.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and consulting skills.
* Commitment to delivering an outstanding candidate experience.
* Strong understanding of diversity and inclusion principles within hiring practices.


   Desirable Criteria
 * Industry\-recognised recruitment qualification.

* Advanced social media recruiting skills.
* Experience leading selection interviews.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
Every day, millions of vehicle owners depend on dealership service departments to keep them on the road. We build the software that helps those service teams communicate with customers, schedule repairs, approve work, collect payments, and deliver a better experience from start to finish.
   

  

 myKaarma is a leading SaaS platform serving dealerships across North America. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, with a global team, we're growing by solving real operational problems with practical technology.
   

  

 We believe the best ideas come from people who take ownership, question how things can be improved, and care deeply about the customer experience. If you're excited to build products that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Role Description**
 myKaarma is looking for a hands\-on Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to help us identify and hire exceptional talent as we continue to grow in India.
   

  

 This role is well suited for someone who combines the energy and execution needed for high\-volume recruiting with the judgment, organization, and technical fluency required to recruit for a growing software company. You will own searches from initial planning through offer acceptance while also building scalable programs for campus hiring, employee referrals, interview events, and candidate assessment.
   

  

 The right person is a strong recruiter and project manager; someone who can turn a hiring goal into a clear plan, coordinate many moving pieces, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and create an excellent candidate experience.
   

  

**How To Stand Out**
 This role requires more than strong recruiting fundamentals. We are looking for a technical thinker who can diagnose difficult hiring challenges, test new approaches, and create experiences that make exceptional candidates want to join myKaarma.
   

  

 Here is an example of the type of scenario we may explore:
   

  

 Question:
 
**You need to hire 25 high\-quality software engineers within 90 days, but myKaarma has limited employer\-brand awareness in a highly competitive market. Job postings and traditional outreach are not producing enough qualified candidates. How would you approach the challenge?**
 What will help you stand out:
 **First, I’d work backward from 25 hires in 90 days to establish the required hiring pace, or takt time, and map the recruiting funnel to identify the constraint.**
**I might create a recurring myKaarma Engineering Challenge Day. We would invite a curated group of engineers to solve a realistic, sanitized product problem alongside members of our engineering team. Candidates would experience how we work, meet future colleagues, and demonstrate their technical thinking through the work itself.**
**The event would combine assessment, employer branding, and interviews into one structured experience, with standardized evaluation criteria and same\-day decisions. After each event, I would review conversion data and candidate feedback, identify where candidates stalled or disengaged, and improve the next session.**
**The goal would be to create a repeatable hiring system that improves speed and quality while giving strong engineers an experience they would talk about, even if they were not hired.**
 We are not looking for one “right” answer. We want to see how you break down the problem, use data to identify constraints, and develop solutions beyond standard recruiting tactics. Ultimately, we want to understand how you would make myKaarma a company talented people actively compete to join.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead full\-cycle recruiting for software, technology, and other priority roles in India.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, sourcing strategies, interview plans, and selection criteria.
* Build and manage campus recruiting programs, including university partnerships, hiring events, assessments, interview days, and offer coordination.

Subros produces compressors, condensers, heat exchangers, and complete AC loop components for passenger vehicles, buses, trucks, refrigeration transport, off\-road equipment, residential air conditioners, and railways. Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Non\-IT Recruiter to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities across various business functions. In this role, you will partner closely with your reporting manager to design and execute effective talent acquisition strategies, identify high\-quality candidates, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. This is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment that rewards innovation, relationship building, and recruitment excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with the reporting manager to understand hiring needs and deliver recruitment goals within defined timelines.
* Create and manage job postings across job boards, social media channels, ATS platforms, and other sourcing avenues.
* Develop sourcing strategies and role\-specific assessment criteria based on market insights and recruitment trends.
* Build strong partnerships with hiring managers to understand current and future hiring requirements.
* Source top talent using job boards, social platforms, professional networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding support.
* Conduct candidate assessments, schedule interviews, and facilitate offer discussions and negotiations.
* Develop and maintain strong candidate relationships to build robust talent pipelines.
* Track recruitment metrics and implement process improvements to enhance hiring outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations, and company policies.


 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* 4\-7 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* Experience hiring for BPO, customer service, and other non\-technical operation roles.
* Proven track record in both niche hiring and high\-volume recruitment.
* Experience in employer branding initiatives through LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
* Strong sourcing and talent\-mapping capabilities.
* Experience with social recruiting, candidate engagement, and talent intelligence.
* Demonstrated success with offer management and negotiations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in conducting weekend walk\-in drives
* Strong interviewing, assessment, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting, and recruitment analytics.


 \#VensureHRIndia
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Talent Acquisition Business Partner
description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida, Pune
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
   

  

 Req Id: 12197
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 9/9/26
   

  

 We are looking for a bilingual (French/English) IT Recruiter based in India to join our North American Talent Acquisition team. This is a fully remote position, supporting hiring activities across Canada and the United States. The successful candidate must be available to work primarily during Eastern Time (ET) business hours to effectively partner with hiring managers, candidates, and internal stakeholders across North America.
   

  

 In this role, you will manage the full recruitment lifecycle for technical and professional positions, partnering closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and hire top talent. The ideal candidate is passionate about recruitment, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and enjoys building strong relationships while delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Consult with management to identify hiring requirements, job specifications, job duties, qualifications and skills.
* Develop compelling job postings and publish opportunities across internal and external recruitment platforms.
* Manage candidate pipelines and maintain accurate recruitment data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Responsible for recruiting process:
+ Sourcing candidates through various channels
+ Screening resumes and conducting phone screenings
+ Conducting HR interviews and candidate assessments
+ Preparing interview summaries and HR recommendations
+ Updating recruitment systems and maintaining accurate documentation
+ Communicating and following up with hiring managers, candidates, and internal stakeholders throughout the recruitment process
+ Coordinating interviews and facilitating the selection process
+ Extending employment offers and negotiating terms when appropriate
+ Managing offer acceptance through to pre\-onboarding activities

* Proactively source passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter and other talent sourcing tools.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring teams,serving as a trusted talent advisor.
* Team work, collaborate with others recruiting partners and conduct initial qualification interviews.
* Develop and implement recruitment strategies in partnership with leadership to support business growth.
* Utilize innovative sourcing techniques, including LinkedIn, social media, networking, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Act as the primary liaison between candidates, hiring managers, and Human Resources throughout the recruitment process.
* Provide regular recruitment updates, pipeline metrics, and market insights to leadership.
* Ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and recruitment best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize recruitment processes and enhance the candidate experience.
* Support employer branding initiatives by promoting Fujitsu's employment value


**Requirements**
* Based in India and able to work remotely
* Ability and willingness to work primarily during Eastern Time (Canada/U.S.) business hours.
* Fully bilingual in English and French (written and spoken).
* Minimum 5 years of full\-cycle IT recruitment experience, preferably supporting North American clients (strong asset)
* Experience recruiting for a wide range of technical roles, including software development, infrastructure, software architecture, cloud, cybersecurity etc.
* Experience in both corporate and agency recruiting.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Strong knowledge of recruitment best practices, employment legislation, and compliance requirements.
* Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI\-powered recruitment tools and technologies to improve sourcing, screening, and recruitment efficiency.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.


 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e recruteur·e TI bilingue (français/anglais) basé(e) en Inde pour se joindre à notre équipe nord\-américaine d’acquisition de talents. Il s’agit d’un poste entièrement en télétravail, soutenant les activités de recrutement au Canada et aux États\-Unis. La personne retenue devra être disponible pour travailler principalement selon les heures de bureau du fuseau horaire de l’Est (HE) afin de collaborer efficacement avec les gestionnaires d’embauche, les candidats et les partenaires internes partout en Amérique du Nord.
   

  

 Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de recrutement pour des postes en TI. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires afin d’attirer, d’évaluer et d’embaucher les meilleurs talents. La personne idéale est passionnée par le recrutement, s’épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et le travail d’équipe et sait bâtir des relations de confiance tout en offrant une expérience candidat exceptionnelle.
   

  

**Responsabilités**
* Collaborer avec les gestionnaires afin de définir les besoins d’embauche, les descriptions de poste, les responsabilités, les qualifications et les compétences recherchées.
* Rédiger des affichages de poste attrayants et les publier sur les plateformes de recrutement internes et externes.
* Gérer les bassins de candidats et maintenir des données de recrutement exactes dans le système de suivi des candidatures (ATS).
* Assurer l’ensemble du processus de recrutement, incluant :

* Le tri des CV et les présélections téléphoniques / visio
* La conduite d’entrevues RH et l’évaluation des candidats
* La préparation des comptes rendus d’entrevue et des recommandations
* La mise à jour des systèmes de recrutement et le maintien d’une documentation précise
* Les communications et suivis auprès des gestionnaires, des candidats et des partenaires internes tout au long du processus de recrutement
* La coordination des entrevues et le soutien au processus de sélection
* La présentation des offres d’emploi et, au besoin, la négociation des conditions d’embauche
* La gestion de l’acceptation des offres jusqu’aux activités précédant l’intégration
* Effectuer de manière proactive la recherche de candidats passifs à l’aide de LinkedIn Recruiter et d’autres outils de recherche de talents.
* Développer et maintenir de solides relations avec les équipes d’embauche en agissant à titre de conseiller(ère) de confiance en acquisition de talents.
* Travailler en équipe, collaborer avec les autres partenaires du recrutement et réaliser les entrevues de présélection.
* Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de recrutement en partenariat avec la direction afin de soutenir la croissance de l’entreprise.
* Utiliser des techniques de recrutement innovantes, notamment LinkedIn, les médias sociaux, le réseautage, les programmes de recommandation et d’autres canaux de recrutement.
* Agir à titre de principal point de contact entre les candidats, les gestionnaires d’embauche et les partenaires des ressources humaines tout au long du processus de recrutement.
* Fournir régulièrement à la direction des mises à jour sur les recrutements, les indicateurs de performance et les tendances du marché.
* Veiller au respect des lois du travail, des politiques de l’entreprise et des meilleures pratiques en matière de recrutement.
* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de recrutement en identifiant des occasions d’optimisation et d’amélioration de l’expérience candidat.
* Soutenir les initiatives liées à la marque employeur Fujitsu


**Exigences**
* Être basé(e) en Inde et être en mesure de travailler à distance.
* Être disponible et disposé(e) à travailler principalement selon les heures de bureau du fuseau horaire de l’Est (Canada/États\-Unis).
* Être parfaitement bilingue en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
* Posséder un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience en recrutement TI à cycle complet, idéalement auprès de clients nord\-américains (atout important).
* Posséder une expérience du recrutement pour une grande variété de postes techniques, notamment en développement logiciel, infrastructure, architecture logicielle, infonuagique (cloud), cybersécurité, etc.
* Posséder une expérience en recrutement en entreprise ainsi qu’en agence.
* Détenir un baccalauréat en ressources humaines, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience).
* Démontrer une excellente connaissance des meilleures pratiques en recrutement, de la législation du travail et des exigences en matière de conformité.
* Avoir de l’expérience avec les systèmes de suivi des candidatures (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter et d’autres plateformes de recherche de talents.
* Maîtriser les outils de recrutement propulsés par l’intelligence artificielle afin d’optimiser le sourcing, le présélection et l’efficacité des processus de recrutement.
* Posséder d’excellentes aptitudes en communication, en relations interpersonnelles et en gestion des parties prenantes.
* Faire preuve d’un excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités dans un environnement où plusieurs dossiers sont menés simultanément.
* Maîtriser la suite Microsoft Office.

 Industry \- EdTech

 We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Executive with around 6 months to 1\+ year of experience to join our recruitment team in the EdTech industry. * Follow up with candidates throughout the selection process.
* Assist with offer rollout, salary discussions, and joining formalities.
* Maintain candidate records, recruitment trackers, and daily hiring reports.
* Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand requirements and recruitment priorities.
* Meet recruitment targets and defined TAT/KPIs.

* 6 months 1\+ year of experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment.
* Basic experience in Non\-IT recruitment preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri/Resdex is preferred.
* Good sourcing and candidate\-screening skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good follow\-up and coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple open positions.

 Candidate Profile
